en.t: This old poem is included in the Later Collection of Japanese Poems, and it reads: "

units.source_text: 焦急心如焚，无人问苦衷。

en.t: My anxious heart burns as if on fire, yet no one asks about my suffering.

units.source_text: 经年盼待久，犹不许相逢。”

en.t: For years I have waited and longed, and still I am not allowed to meet you."
